sections.summary: Replace launcher-only boundary enforcement with one neutral guarded-owner registry that prevents duplicate owners, unowned exception boundaries, raw public exception escape, and unclassified catch/code regrowth without becoming a semantic policy engine.
sections.why_it_matters: The repository repeatedly fixes individual ownership and exception incidents because proof is organized around known examples. One deny-by-default registry must enforce owner identity and boundary translation as pattern classes, while semantic decisions remain with WK-2357, WK-2359, WK-2382, and the existing launcher owners.

items: Generalize the existing DEC-0142 launcher scanner into a neutral guarded-owner registry and engine.
Preserve specialized category semantics while sharing production discovery and owner-resolution mechanics.
Consume the WK-2359 exception-disposition corpus and enforce complete classification of the fresh catch/code populations.
Replace anonymous allowlisting with exact temporary defect entries tied to canonical owner WKs and mechanical sunset conditions.
Mutation-test unauthorized owners, boundary escape, unclassified catches/codes, source moves, copied policies, and stale temporary entries.
out_of_scope: Defining public refusal meanings or recovery actions, owned by WK-2359.
Repairing async cache, teardown, or process-supervision behavior, owned by WK-2382.
Implementing durable publication or liveness semantics, owned by WK-2357.
Treating every internal exception code or non-propagating catch as defective without semantic evidence.
Adding production behavior changes merely to satisfy the scanner.

closure.summary: Completed under the operator-authorized direct-to-main lifecycle. The neutral guarded-owner registry, complete WK-2359/WK-2382 population reconciliation, launcher/durability adapters, dual-family injection guards, and repository lint enforcement are landed on local main through final commit ed641ab2dbb15cfe647e8e600fef5f3af52eedb7. The exact combined implementation review ran once in SLICE-022, its findings were challenged once in SLICE-029, all retained findings were dispositioned and remediated in this closure story, and no remediation was re-reviewed. Direct-to-main authorization means no terminal-review unit or forge handoff applies.
validation: All 22 non-cancelled slices are done; seven superseded/unneeded slices are cancelled and none remain active, in review, or blocked.
Final guarded-owner lint passed with zero gating diagnostics across 836 files and 7,837 sites; 7,642 corpus-absent facts remain explicit and non-gating by contract.
All focused registry, reconciliation, mutation, witness, boundary, durability, findings-routing, preflight, dispatch-ergonomics, and response-deduplication validations reported passing.

Final controlled references are current at commit ed641ab2dbb15cfe647e8e600fef5f3af52eedb7; the proof plan was rebuilt and all 42 obligation rows plus all 11 acceptance rows were mechanically rebased without semantic change.
